summary: Tested GrimorioApp backend (10 pytest cases) and frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844). Backend: 10/10 pass — 84 spells seeded, search, all filters (livello/scuola/classe), meta and detail endpoints work; no _id leakage. Frontend: Home → CTA → Grimorio → search 'aculeo' (1 result) → filter chip Livello=0 (Trucchetti) → Pulisci chip appears → tap spell row → detail screen renders (hero image, title, school badge, meta grid, classes, description) → favorite FAB toggles → Preferiti tab persists the favorite ('1 incantesimo salvato', Amicizia). All primary user flows verified end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Hero image container and meta grid render visually but expected testIDs 'detail-hero' and 'detail-meta' are missing. Only detail-favorite-fab and detail-title present.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='detail-hero' to the hero image wrapper and testID='detail-meta' to the meta grid container in app/spell/[id].tsx for future test automation.
(Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
parse_livello handles both 'Trucchetto di ...' (livello_num=0) and 'X° livello' formats — validated by tests.
Regex-escaped user input in search filter (re.escape) — safe.
app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows pass; 2 detail testIDs missing but content renders)
